$comment: Pre-approves the commands this build actually needs, so Claude Code can
work without stopping for permission every few seconds.
This is deliberately narrow. The older advice was to launch with
--dangerously-skip-permissions, which switches off ALL safety checks for
the whole session. That is a bad habit to learn: it is fine on a throwaway
project and genuinely risky on a machine with work files on it. This list
gets you the same smooth run without teaching you to disable the seatbelt.
Anything not listed here still asks first — which is what you want.
